about: Aggregates of open wildlife records in the Docklands model box for the wildlife simulation of the Three.js port (docklands/layers/wildlife.js): records per species, per habitat class (records located to 100 m or better), per month; a habitat raster. No record points. Built by cwplans/tools/fetch-wildlife.mjs.
caveats: Record counts measure where and when people record, not how many animals there are: common birds (feral pigeon) are under-recorded, scarce ones over-recorded. The simulation blends them with general ecology (weights) and its own densities.

Habitat of a record: its point in the 10 m habitat raster, or water within 30 m (waterbirds are recorded from the bank). Records with a coordinate uncertainty over 100 m (grid squares, mostly 1 km) count only for the totals and the months.

species.name: Feral pigeon
species.ecology: Resident all year; flocks of 10 to 50 on squares, streets and ledges; roosts on buildings and under bridges.

species.name: Woodpigeon
species.ecology: Resident; parks and gardens; larger flocks in winter.

species.name: Mallard
species.ecology: Resident; docks, ponds and the river edge; dabbles, does not dive.

species.name: Tufted duck
species.ecology: Mostly winter (October to March); docks and lakes; dives for food.

species.name: Canada goose
species.ecology: Resident (introduced); grazes park grass in flocks; docks and lakes.

species.name: Greylag goose
species.ecology: Resident (feral); with Canada geese on lakes and grass.

species.name: Egyptian goose
species.ecology: Resident (introduced); lakes and parks; nests in trees.

species.name: Coot
species.ecology: Resident; more in winter; docks and lakes; dives briefly.

species.name: Moorhen
species.ecology: Resident; dock and pond edges, reeds; feeds on banks.

species.name: Cormorant
species.ecology: All year, most in winter; fishes in the Thames and the docks (dives for 20 to 60 s); dries its wings on posts and piers.

species.name: Mute swan
species.ecology: Resident; docks and the river; pairs, small groups in winter.

species.name: Great crested grebe
species.ecology: Resident in the docks (Millwall, Greenland, South Dock); dives for fish; pairs in spring.

species.name: Black-headed gull
species.ecology: Most numerous gull in winter (August to March); river, docks, parks.

species.name: Herring gull
species.ecology: All year; river, roofs; nests on roofs.

species.name: Lesser black-backed gull
species.ecology: Mostly summer; roofs and the river; some all winter.

species.name: Common gull
species.ecology: Winter only (October to March); grass and the river.

species.name: Great black-backed gull
species.ecology: Few; the river, mostly winter.

species.name: Carrion crow
species.ecology: Resident; parks, foreshore, streets.

species.name: Magpie
species.ecology: Resident; parks and gardens.

species.name: Grey heron
species.ecology: Resident; stands at dock and river edges; flies slowly with neck folded.

species.name: Red fox
species.ecology: Resident (London: about 18 a km2, Natural History Museum and Mammal Society estimates); mostly active at dusk and at night; dens in woods, embankments and gardens.
